run_evaluate_model: run the evaluate function to evaluate a demucs model on the musdb test set using museval metrics
compute_new_sdr: compute the new SDR score from the MDX challenge definition given reference and estimate tensors
eval_single_track: evaluate a single track by computing both original SDR and new SDR metrics using eval_track
run_museval_bss_eval: run museval blind source separation evaluation on reference and estimate audio signals with a window and hop
review_evaluate_metrics: review the evaluate function to understand how SDR, SIR, ISR, and SAR metrics are aggregated across tracks
